title: False Ad! These towels are not soft, large...Thin rags
text: False Ad! These towels are not soft, large...Thin rags. Unhappy. I will gladly pay 70.00 for one towel as advertised but four towels that are no better than thin wash cloths. The maker didn't care. Offered for me to pack up, ship back. Live and learn.

product_metadata.title: Maura Luxury Turkish Cotton Bath Towel Sets 8pc - Soft, Thick, Plush & Super Absorbent Hotel & Spa Quality Oversized Hand Towels for Bathroom - Adult Size - Burgundy
features: Size Matters: Designed specifically for American standard towel sizes, we understand that you desire to wrap your entire body in your towels. That's why we don't produce small bath towels for American customers. Our thick bath towels adhere to standard size guidelines: Bath Towels at 30 by 56 inches, Hand Towels at 16 by 30 inches, and Washcloths at 13 by 13 inches, which are larger than most market offerings. These dimensions ensure a wide and long coverage for your body.

Quality: Our Turkish towel collections are crafted from pure cotton, featuring double stitched hems for added durability. They are Made in Green by Oeko Tex M1YLNKWV7 Hohenstein certified, meaning the bath towel sets are tested for harmful substances, produced in safer workplaces, and have reduced environmental impacts. These long-lasting bath towels offer the same quality you would find in luxury department stores, and you'll adore their high absorbency in your bathroom.

Trendy Colors and Patterns: Turkish bath towel sets are made of soft linen, plush, luxurious, and ultra absorbent cotton, uniquely designed by top designers based on the latest fast fashion design trends. Solid colors are inspired by nature tones. The stress reducing palette is influenced by the Japanese practice of Shinrin Yoku. Your bathroom will consistently look fresh and trendy with our extensive linen bath towel collections, connecting you to nature and enhancing your mood.

Color Lock Technology: Laboratory tested and hypoallergenic, our color lock technology ensures that the original shade of your luxury bath towels remains intact even after numerous washes. They boast the highest level of stain resistance, but are not bleach safe. Please follow the washing instructions on your towel labels to keep them looking new after many uses. His and her bath towel sets are also available.

Great Value: This 8 piece towel set includes 2 bath, 2 hand, and 4 washcloths. Our Turkish cotton bath towel set comes in 9 different stress-reducing colors: white, sand, sage green, baby blue, denim blue, space grey, burgundy, dark green, and brown. If you're looking for other colors, please click our brand name to explore options like black, gold pink, yellow, rust, taupe, tan, hunter midnight green, anthracite, brown, coral, and cream.

details.Product Care Instructions: Machine wash warm, tumble dry low.
